title: SAFTER: Safety-Aware Filtering Through Explicit Recoverability for Robust Reinforcement Learning under Distribution Shift
abstract: arXiv:2610.29149v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning safe policies that generalize to unseen environments is difficult under bounded actuation, where an unsafe decision may become unrecoverable. Conventional control barrier function (CBF) filters enforce only instantaneous safety and ignore future recoverability. We propose SAFTER (Safety-Aware Filtering Through Explicit Recoverability), which embeds a differentiable, closed-form backup-CBF filter into Soft Actor-Critic training. SAFTER unifies current safety, finite-horizon backup safety, terminal recoverability, and input admissibility into a single differentiable certificate. Its CBF condition yields an exact minimum-intervention projection without iterative online optimization. In quadruped navigation, SAFTER reaches 90% training success with 30.6% fewer transitions than Vanilla SAC and 34.1-35.1% fewer than current-state CBF-filtered SAC baselines. Across unseen simulated environments, SAFTER improves success by up to 42.4

translated_title: SAFTER：面向分布偏移下鲁棒强化学习的基于显式可恢复性的安全感知滤波
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.29149v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：在执行器能力受限的条件下，学习能够泛化到未见环境的安全策略十分困难，因为一个不安全的决策可能导致系统变得不可恢复。传统的控制屏障函数（CBF）滤波器仅强制执行瞬时安全性，而忽略了未来的可恢复性。我们提出了SAFTER（通过显式可恢复性进行安全感知滤波），它将一个可微分的、具有闭式解的备份CBF滤波器嵌入到Soft Actor-Critic训练中。SAFTER将当前安全性、有限时域备份安全性、终端可恢复性和输入可容许性统一为一个单一的可微分证书。其CBF条件能够产生精确的最小干预投影，而无需迭代的在线优化。在四足机器人导航任务中，SAFTER达到了90%的训练成功率，比Vanilla SAC少使用30.6%的转移样本，比基于当前状态的CBF滤波SAC基线少使用34.1%-35.1%的转移样本。在未见过的模拟环境中，SAFTER将成功率最多提升了42.4%。
tldr: SAFTER通过将可微分的闭式备份CBF滤波器嵌入SAC训练，把当前安全性、备份安全性和可恢复性统一为单一可微分证书，在分布偏移下的四足导航任务中显著提升了成功率并大幅降低样本消耗。
en_tdlr: SAFTER embeds a differentiable closed-form backup-CBF filter into Soft Actor-Critic training, unifying current safety, backup safety, and recoverability into a single differentiable certificate, significantly improving success rates and sample efficiency in quadruped navigation under distribution shift.
